DriverProfile.title: DriverProfile
DriverProfile.description: Authenticated driver cloud profile storing offline career progression, selected vehicle, active mods, and vehicle ownership.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the driver who owns this profile.

displayName.description: Public driver callsign shown on menus and garage.

careerLights.description: Total unique permanent Lights earned across career events.

offlineCredits.description: Local career credits (strictly separate from server-verified online economy).

unlockedVehicles.description: Bounded list of unlocked vehicle IDs (max 10).

equippedMods.description: Up to 3 equipped passive mod IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

CareerEventRecord.title: CareerEventRecord
CareerEventRecord.description: Best verified career result and permanent Lights for a single career event under a driver profile.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the parent driver profile.

bestPosition.description: Best finishing position (1-20) or 1 for cleared challenge.

bestScore.description: Highest event score or destruction points.

bestTimeMs.description: Fastest event completion time in milliseconds.

lightsEarned.description: Permanent Lights earned for this event (0-5).

fanRunCompleted.description: Whether the optional Fan Run gate sequence was completed.

fanDemandCompleted.description: Whether the event Fan Demand objective was completed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when best record was updated.

VehicleMasteryRecord.title: VehicleMasteryRecord
VehicleMasteryRecord.description: Per-vehicle progression and mastery statistics owned by a driver.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the parent driver profile.

racesCompleted.description: Total completed races in this vehicle.

bestLapMs.description: Best lap time in milliseconds (0 if unset).

defensiveActions.description: Total shield blocks, interceptions, and evasions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial mastery record.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest mastery update.

/drivers/{driverId}.description: Owner-isolated driver cloud profile storing offline career progression and customization.

/drivers/{driverId}/careerEvents/{eventI.description: Per-event best career records and permanent Lights under a driver's profile.

/drivers/{driverId}/vehicleMastery/{vehi.description: Per-vehicle progression and mastery statistics under a driver's profile.
